Keisha A: Drafting outbound for customers whose onboarding stalled due to this morning's ingest timeout spike. Short + clear.

Keisha A: ```Hi <CustomerContact>,

Status: Mitigated — ingest throughput restored.

What happened: a deploy caused an ingestion timeout regression between 09:20 and 09:58 UTC, leading to intermittent failures for large onboarding imports. Existing live inference and previously indexed content were not affected.

What we did: rolled back the deploy, replayed queued batches for high-touch tenants, and restored normal throughput at 09:58 UTC.

If you saw failed imports: reply with the job ID and consent to a managed replay. Our target window for managed replays is 24-72 hours; for very large imports we'll coordinate a custom schedule.

Compensation: affected tenants may be eligible for a one-time onboarding credit up to one day of ingestion usage (subject to verification).

Resources: status.redwood.ai (incident #2026-ING-RT), replay console: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/<tenant-id>/replays

If this impacts an active renewal, tag your renewal manager and CS leadership will escalate.

— Keisha & CS Ops
```

Marco D: legal asked to change "will" to "may" and add "subject to verification" for credits.

LegalBot: Approved.

Keisha A: scheduling outbound at 13:15 UTC. OpsBot, queue please.
